offer.text: The light's right for a survey, but it won't last. Bring me a compass and 4 glass panes before dusk and we'll chart the ridge today.

accept.text: Quick now — shadows lengthen fast out here.

decline.text: Another clear day will come. Probably.

in_progress.text: Daylight's burning — the compass and glass, hurry!

ready.text: Just in time! Hold the lens steady while I sketch.

complete.text: We've charted the ridge. The frontier proper is next — and I can't imagine doing it without you.

failed.text: Dusk beat us, and the survey's spoilt. Don't fret — come by tomorrow and we'll salvage what we can.
